name: rentemester-supplier-commitment-occurrence-matches-v31
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supplier_commitment_occurrence_matches (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 commitment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 occurrence_date TEXT NOT NULL,
 expected_payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 evidence_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(evidence_kind IN ('canonical_document','payable','bank_transaction')),
 evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 canonical_payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(canonical_payload)),
 payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_hash)=64),
 actor TEXT NOT NULL,
 principal TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(commitment_id, occurrence_date),
 UNIQUE(evidence_kind, evidence_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS supplier_commitment_occurrence_matches_commitment ON supplier_commitment_occurrence_matches(commitment_id, occurrence_date);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS supplier_commitment_occurrence_matches_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON supplier_commitment_occurrence_matches BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'supplier commitment occurrence matches are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS supplier_commitment_occurrence_matches_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON supplier_commitment_occurrence_matches BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'supplier commitment occurrence matches are append-only'); END;
